senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) toil, trouble; fruit of labor, achievement.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 10</cite> <he>אפי׳ מלכותו ע׳ ואוו</he> even man’s rulership is toil and vanity; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 841:17">Yalk. ib. 841</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:6">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>אשרי מי … ועֲמָלוֹ בתורה</he> blessed he that has been reared in the Law, and whose toil is in the Law.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>שהיתה … בעמלו של רשע</he> a curse rested on the wicked man’s labor.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 22:3">Ex. R. s. 22</cite> <he>שלא היה בעמלו גזל</he> in whose acquired property there was no robbery; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:15">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>בית הע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00149"><he>דָּהוֹן</he></cite>.
